head: 7a8dd808cfe78303a7b6910c94b41e2b1da84250
claim: The README's hero is a real capture of the example web app: the Agents page shows the Codex agent running on the ChatGPT plan the person already pays for, with its default model, and pay-per-use API keys listed apart, in light and dark at phone and desktop widths.

steps.start: The example web app built from this checkout, opened at phone and desktop widths in light and dark, with no agent signed in and no account connected.
steps: Opened the example app's Agents page in headless Chromium at 1280x800 and 390x844, in light and dark.
Signed in the Codex agent with the loopback ChatGPT stand-in, so the account the person already pays for is the one in use.
Chose the default model for new runs and expanded the pay-per-use group, which lists API keys apart from the plan.
Reloaded the page and confirmed the chosen account and model survived.
steps.result: The Agents page shows Codex on the ChatGPT plan account in use with its default model, and pay-per-use API keys listed separately, in both themes and both widths; the frames the README ships are cut from this capture.

verdicts.seen: Agents page, Codex expanded: "ChatGPT — Uses your ChatGPT plan", "umer@example.com / In use", "Pay per use (1)" section listing "OpenAI API key", and "Default model GPT-6 Sol" with "New runs use GPT-6 Sol." Light background, full-width desktop layout (~1280px). All parts of the outcome are present; no overlay or error.

Same Agents page in dark theme at desktop width: "Codex — 1 of 1 enabled", "ChatGPT / Uses your ChatGPT plan", "umer@example.com / In use", "Pay per use (1)" with "OpenAI API key", "Default model GPT-6 Sol". No overlay or contradiction.

Narrow phone-width, light theme capture of the Agents page: "Codex 1 of 1 enabled", "ChatGPT / Uses your ChatGPT plan", "umer@example.com / In use", "Pay per use (1)" → "OpenAI API key", "Default model GPT-6 Sol". Content fully visible, no keyboard overlay.

Narrow phone-width, dark theme: "Codex 1 of 1 enabled", "ChatGPT / Uses your ChatGPT plan", "umer@example.com / In use", "Pay per use (1)" with "OpenAI API key", "Default model GPT-6 Sol", "New runs use GPT-6 Sol." Nothing hidden.
